plain: To blame or credit someone for something

webster.text: To charge; to attribute; to set to the account of; generally ill, sometimes good.

example.quote: It must, however, be admitted, that our federal system is defective, and that some of the state governments are not well administered; but, then, we impute to the defects in our governments many evils and embarrassments which are most clearly the result of the late war.
example.cite: Letters from the Federal Farmer to the Republican, Letter I, Oct. 8, 1787
